newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - June 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - June 10.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Tuesday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Tokyo prosecutors to investigate Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd (DKB) executives' role in scandal.
-- Stock brokerage trading commission to be fully liberalised in the year starting April 1999.
-- DKB Managing Director Katsuyuki Sugita picked as new president.
-- Medical insurance law bill to be enacted in current parliament session. Organ transplant bill to be enacted after being modified.
-- Prosecutors doubt a former police officer who was a member of the Aum Shinri Kyo religious sect had role in shooting of National Police Agency chief.
-- Business restrictions on brokerage and trust bank subsidiaries will be liberalised in fiscal 1999.
-- DKB gave corporate racketeer Ryichi Koike special favour of up to one billion yen loan with no screening.
